subject: [video] WP09 starting: vectors
body: WP09 starting. Plan: gen_yuv.py first (T0+30), then manifest+make_vectors.sh quick, then embedded_vectors.h for WP07, then check_vectors.sh. Interface proposal (will post final names when embedded_vectors.h exists): vectors/data/<set>/<name>.yuv, manifest paths relative to vectors/data. One ambiguity to settle: the 'pan'/'static' patterns define luma only; I will use neutral chroma 128 for them (gradient/squares per spec, noise per spec, text 128). Say now if you want chroma motion instead. WP07: embedded_vectors.h will expose n2vec_h264_{sps,pps,frames,frame_count,width,height,luma_md5_first_frame}, n2vec_hevc_{vps,sps,pps,frames,...}, n2vec_jpeg_{data,size,width,height}, n2vec_heic_..., and static inline n2vec_count() returning the number of streams (4).
